ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( Account.Agreement_signed__c = FALSE, ISBLANK(Account.Agreement_type__c), ISBLANK( Account.Agreement_Date__c ), ISBLANK(TEXT( Account.Revenue_Share_to_Partner__c )), ISBLANK(Account.Link_to_Agreement__c) ) && AND( RecordType.Name = 'Partner', ISCHANGED( StageName ), ISPICKVAL( StageName,"Closed Won") )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please ensure the following Account fields are populated before moving to Closed Won: [Agreement Signed], [Agreement Type], [Agreement Date], [Revenue Share (to Partner)], [Link to Agreement]
